title: Locally Adaptive Conformal Prediction for Polynomial Chaos Expansions
abstract: arXiv:2611.09579v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: This work develops a locally adaptive jackknife+ conformal prediction framework for polynomial chaos expansions. Therein, the non-conformity scores are normalized with an auxiliary polynomial chaos expansion trained on the log-transformed leave-one-out residuals of the base model. We show that the coverage guarantee of jackknife+ conformal prediction carries over to the adaptive intervals if the leave-one-out auxiliary models are trained on nested leave-one-out residuals. For fixed-basis polynomial chaos expansions fitted by ordinary least squares, all required quantities are derived in closed form and the guarantee-preserving adaptive intervals are obtained from a single model fit, without any model retraining. For sparse polynomial chaos expansions, where multiple model fits are necessary, we propose a heuristic simplification that limits the computational overhead of adaptivity at the cost of the formal coverage guarantee. translated_title: 多项式混沌展开的局部自适应保形预测
translated_abstract: 本工作为多项式混沌展开开发了一种局部自适应的jackknife+保形预测框架。其中，非一致性得分通过一个辅助多项式混沌展开进行归一化，该辅助模型基于基础模型的对数变换留一残差进行训练。我们证明了如果留一辅助模型是在嵌套的留一残差上训练的，那么jackknife+保形预测的覆盖保证可以延续到自适应区间。对于通过普通最小二乘法拟合的固定基多项式混沌展开，所有所需量均以闭式形式推导得出，且保持覆盖保证的自适应区间可从单次模型拟合中获得，无需任何模型重训练。对于需要多次模型拟合的稀疏多项式混沌展开，我们提出了一种启发式简化方法，以牺牲形式化的覆盖保证为代价来限制自适应性的计算开销。
tldr: 该论文提出了针对多项式混沌展开的局部自适应jackknife+保形预测框架，通过在嵌套留一残差上训练辅助模型进行归一化，在固定基展开情形下仅需单次模型拟合即可获得具有覆盖保证的自适应预测区间。
en_tdlr: This paper proposes a locally adaptive jackknife+ conformal prediction framework for polynomial chaos expansions, where coverage-guaranteed adaptive prediction intervals are obtained from a single model fit in the fixed-basis case through auxiliary models trained on nested leave-one-out residuals.
